description: relay_queue.rs writes envelope files atomically: the .msg file is written to a .tmp and renamed first, then the .env sidecar. On crash between the two renames, drain_once detects the orphan .msg (no .env) and cleans it up. This ordering ensures no envelope without a message body can exist, and no message body that looks deliverable is missing its envelope. The write order is the correct crash-safe choice.
title: smtp: atomic write order (msg.tmp→msg, env.tmp→env) ensures crash safety
